title: Register Renaming (RAT + Free List)
constraints: 8 architectural and 16 physical registers. Reset: RAT[i] = i, and the free list is a FIFO holding 8, 9, …, 15 in that order.
All outputs are registered. On an edge with `ren_valid = 1`, `ps1` / `ps2` = RAT[rs1] / RAT[rs2] (the mapping **before** this instruction).
If `has_rd`: when the free list is non-empty, pop its head as `pd`, output `old_pd` = RAT[rd], set RAT[rd] = pd, `ren_ok = 1`. When it is empty: `stall = 1`, `ren_ok = 0`, and nothing changes.
`free_valid` pushes `free_preg` onto the tail of the free list **after** this cycle's allocation (it can be allocated from the next cycle on). Must be synthesizable.
hints: RAT: 8 × 4-bit registers. Free list: a 16-entry circular FIFO of 4-bit register numbers with head, tail and count.
`old_pd` goes into the reorder buffer. When the instruction commits, `old_pd` is freed: that is the `free_valid` port.
Read everything you output from the pre-edge state, then update RAT and free list with nonblocking assignments.
